## Project or change

Describe the alternative and the SaaS product it replaces, or explain the correction.

## Checks

- [ ] The source repository is public and is not archived.
- [ ] The license was checked against the project's license file.
- [ ] The description is factual and no longer than 160 characters.
- [ ] There is no duplicate entry under the same SaaS product.
- [ ] `data.json` is valid JSON and matches the README listings.
